bank_allocations_undo_chk.name: bank_allocations_undo_chk
bank_allocations_undo_chk.value: ("bank_allocations"."status" = 'desfeita' and "bank_allocations"."undone_by" is not null and "bank_allocations"."undone_at" is not null and "bank_allocations"."undo_reason" is not null) or ("bank_allocations"."status" = 'ativa' and "bank_allocations"."undone_by" is null and "bank_allocations"."undone_at" is null and "bank_allocations"."undo_reason" is null)

billing_batches_approval_chk.name: billing_batches_approval_chk
billing_batches_approval_chk.value: ("billing_batches"."status" = 'aprovado') = ("billing_batches"."approved_by" is not null and "billing_batches"."approved_at" is not null)

commission_statements_paid_chk.name: commission_statements_paid_chk
commission_statements_paid_chk.value: ("commission_statements"."status" = 'pago') = ("commission_statements"."paid_on" is not null and "commission_statements"."paid_by" is not null)

commission_statements_cancel_chk.name: commission_statements_cancel_chk
commission_statements_cancel_chk.value: ("commission_statements"."status" = 'cancelado') = ("commission_statements"."cancelled_by" is not null and "commission_statements"."cancelled_at" is not null and "commission_statements"."cancel_reason" is not null)

contracts_commission_bps_chk.name: contracts_commission_bps_chk
contracts_commission_bps_chk.value: "contracts"."commission_bps" is null or ("contracts"."commission_bps" between 1 and 10000 and "contracts"."commission_partner" is not null)

issuance_requests_done_chk.name: issuance_requests_done_chk
issuance_requests_done_chk.value: "issuance_requests"."status" not in ('emitido', 'processando') or "issuance_requests"."external_ref" is not null

messaging_settings_limits_chk.name: messaging_settings_limits_chk
messaging_settings_limits_chk.value: "messaging_settings"."max_per_run" between 1 and 500 and "messaging_settings"."max_per_hour" between 1 and 2000 and "messaging_settings"."max_late_days" between 0 and 30

payable_payments_reversal_chk.name: payable_payments_reversal_chk
payable_payments_reversal_chk.value: ("payable_payments"."status" = 'estornado' and "payable_payments"."reversed_by" is not null and "payable_payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "payable_payments"."reverse_reason" is not null) or ("payable_payments"."status" = 'ativo' and "payable_payments"."reversed_by" is null and "payable_payments"."reversed_at" is null and "payable_payments"."reverse_reason" is null)

payable_payments_text_chk.name: payable_payments_text_chk
payable_payments_text_chk.value: ("payable_payments"."reference" is null or char_length("payable_payments"."reference") <= 60) and ("payable_payments"."note" is null or char_length("payable_payments"."note") <= 200)

payables_doc_uq.name: payables_doc_uq
payables_doc_uq.where: "payables"."document_number" is not null and "payables"."status" not in ('cancelado', 'rejeitado')

payables_text_chk.name: payables_text_chk
payables_text_chk.value: char_length("payables"."description") between 2 and 200 and ("payables"."document_number" is null or char_length("payables"."document_number") between 1 and 40) and ("payables"."category" is null or char_length("payables"."category") <= 40)

payables_decision_chk.name: payables_decision_chk
payables_decision_chk.value: case when "payables"."status" in ('aprovado', 'rejeitado') then "payables"."decided_by" is not null and "payables"."decided_at" is not null when "payables"."status" in ('rascunho', 'aguardando_aprovacao') then "payables"."decided_by" is null else true end

payables_cancel_chk.name: payables_cancel_chk
payables_cancel_chk.value: ("payables"."status" = 'cancelado') = ("payables"."cancelled_by" is not null and "payables"."cancelled_at" is not null and "payables"."cancel_reason" is not null)

payments_reversal_chk.name: payments_reversal_chk
payments_reversal_chk.value: ("payments"."status" = 'estornado' and "payments"."reversed_by" is not null and "payments"."reversed_at" is not null and "payments"."reverse_reason" is not null) or ("payments"."status" = 'ativo' and "payments"."reversed_by" is null and "payments"."reversed_at" is null and "payments"."reverse_reason" is null)
